40022651.author: पदार्थः
40022651.content: तथोक्तवति when thus spoken, रामे by Rama, तु indeed, भरते by Bharata, च and, महात्मनि the great-souled, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ then, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनम् to Rama, the delight of the Raghus.

40022651.author: Translation
40022651.content: After Rama and the great-souled Bharata had spoken, Lakshmana then addressed Rama, the delight of the Raghus, with auspicious words.

40022652.author: पदार्थः
40022652.content: अश्वमेधः The Ashwamedha, महायज्ञः a great sacrifice, पावनः purifier, सर्वपाप्मनाम् of all sins, पावनः a purifier, तव for you, दुर्धर्षः unconquerable, रोचताम् may it be pleasing, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022652.author: Translation
40022652.content: O delight of the Raghus, may the Ashwamedha, a great sacrifice and purifier of all sins, which is a purifier for you, the unconquerable one, be pleasing to you.

40022653.author: पदार्थः
40022653.content: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरावृत्तम् an ancient event, वासवे regarding Indra, सुमहात्मनि the very great-souled, ब्रह्महत्यावृतः afflicted by the sin of Brahman-slaughter, शक्रः Indra, हयमेधेन by the Ashwamedha, पावितः was purified.

40022653.author: Translation
40022653.content: Indeed, it is heard that in an ancient event, the very great-souled Indra, afflicted by the sin of Brahman-slaughter, was purified by the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

40022654.author: पदार्थः
40022654.content: पुरा formerly, किल indeed, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, देवासुरसमागमे in the encounter between gods and asuras, वृत्रः Vritra, नाम named, महान् a great one, आसीत् was, दैतेयः a Daitya, लोकसम्मतः renowned in the world.

40022654.author: Translation
40022654.content: O mighty-armed one, it is said that formerly, during the conflict between gods and asuras, there was a great Daitya named Vritra, renowned throughout the world.

40022655.author: पदार्थः
40022655.content: विस्तीर्णः extended, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, उच्छ्रितः tall, त्रिगुणम् three times, ततः than that, अनुरागेण with affection, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, स्नेहात् out of love, पश्यति he saw, सर्वतः everywhere.

40022655.author: Translation
40022655.content: He was a hundred yojanas wide and three times that in height, and he regarded all three worlds everywhere with affection and love.

40022656.author: पदार्थः
40022656.content: धर्मज्ञः righteous, च and, कृतज्ञः grateful, च and, बुद्ध्या with intellect, च and, परिनिष्ठितः perfected, शशास ruled, पृथिवीम् the earth, स्फीताम् prosperous, धर्मेण with righteousness, सुसमाहितः perfectly attentive.

40022656.author: Translation
40022656.content: He, being righteous, grateful, and perfected in intellect, ruled the vast and prosperous earth with perfect attention to dharma.

40022657.author: पदार्थः
40022657.content: तस्मिन् when he, प्रशासति was ruling, तदा then, सर्वकामदुघा wish-fulfilling, मही the earth, रसवन्ति juicy, प्रभूनानि abundant, मूलानि roots, च and, फलानि fruits, च and.

40022657.author: Translation
40022657.content: While he was ruling, the earth became a wish-fulfilling cow, providing abundant and juicy roots and fruits.

40022658.author: पदार्थः
40022658.content: अकृष्टपच्या yielding crops without cultivation, पृथिवी the earth, सुसम्पन्ना well-endowed, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, सः he, राज्यम् kingdom, तादृशम् such, भुङ्क्ते enjoyed, स्फीतम् prosperous, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful appearance.

40022658.author: Translation
40022658.content: The earth, without cultivation, yielded abundant crops for that great-souled king, and he enjoyed such a prosperous and marvelous kingdom.

40022659.author: पदार्थः
40022659.content: तस्य his, बुद्धिः thought, समुप्तन्ना arose, तपः penance, कुर्याम् I should perform, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, तपः penance, हि indeed, परमम् supreme, श्रेयः good, सम्मोहम् delusion, इतरत् other, सुखम् happiness.

40022659.author: Translation
40022659.content: A thought arose in his mind that he should perform unsurpassed penance, for indeed, penance is the supreme good, while other forms of happiness lead to delusion.

40022660.author: पदार्थः
40022660.content: सः he, निक्षिप्य entrusting, सुतम् son, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, पौरेषु among the citizens, मधुरेश्वरम् Madhureśvara, तपः penance, उग्रम् severe, समातिष्ठत् undertook, तापयन् causing to suffer, सर्वदेवताः all deities.

40022660.author: Translation
40022660.content: He entrusted his eldest son, Madhureśvara, to the citizens and undertook severe penance, thereby causing all the deities to suffer.

40022661.author: पदार्थः
40022661.content: तपः penance, तप्यति performs, वृत्रे when Vritra, तु indeed, वासवः Indra, परमार्तवत् like one greatly distressed, विष्णुं to Vishnu, समुपसङ्क्रम्य having approached, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022661.author: Translation
40022661.content: When Vritra was performing penance, Indra, greatly distressed, approached Vishnu and spoke these words.

40022662.author: पदार्थः
40022662.content: तपस्यता by the one performing penance, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, लोकाः the worlds, वृत्रेण by Vritra, निर्जिताः have been conquered, बलवान् powerful, सः he, हि indeed, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, न not, एनं him, शक्ष्यामि I am able, शासितुम् to control.

40022662.author: Translation
40022662.content: O mighty-armed one, Vritra, who is performing penance, has conquered the worlds; he is indeed powerful and righteous, and I am unable to control him.

40022663.author: पदार्थः
40022663.content: यदि if, असौ he, तपः penance, आतिष्ठेत् should perform, भूयः again, एव indeed, असुरेश्वर O lord of Asuras, यावत् as long as, लोकाः the worlds, धरिष्यन्ति will endure, तावत् so long, अस्य his, वशानुगाः subservient.

40022663.author: Translation
40022663.content: O Lord of Asuras, if he performs penance again, the worlds will remain subservient to him as long as they endure.

40022664.author: पदार्थः
40022664.content: तं him, च and, एनं this one, परमोदारम् extremely powerful, उपेक्षसि you disregard, महाबलम् very powerful, क्षणं for a moment, हि indeed, न not, भवेत् would exist, वृत्रः Vritra, क्रुद्धे when angry, त्वयि you, सुरेश्वर O lord of gods.

40022664.author: Translation
40022664.content: And yet you disregard this extremely powerful Vritra; for indeed, Vritra would not exist even for a moment if you, O Lord of gods, were to become angry.

40022665.author: पदार्थः
40022665.content: यदा when, हि indeed, प्रीतिसंयोगं union of affection, त्वया by you, विष्णो O Vishnu, समागतः he obtained, तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, लोकानां of the worlds, नाथत्वम् lordship, उपलब्धवान् he obtained.

40022665.author: Translation
40022665.content: Indeed, it was when he obtained your favor, O Vishnu, that he achieved lordship over the worlds from that time onwards.

40022666.author: पदार्थः
40022666.content: स that, त्वं you, प्रसादं favor, लोकानां of the worlds, कुरुष्व do, सुसमाहितः well-composed, त्वत्कृतेन by your doing, हि indeed, सर्वं all, स्यात् would be, प्रशान्तम् peaceful, अरुजं free from suffering, जगत् world.

40022666.author: Translation
40022666.content: You, being well-composed, should bestow your favor upon the worlds, for by your action alone, the entire world would become peaceful and free from suffering.

40022667.author: पदार्थः
40022667.content: इमे these, हि indeed, सर्वे all, विष्णो O Vishnu, त्वां you, निरीक्षन्ते await, दिवौकसः gods, वृत्रघातेन by the slaying of Vritra, महता great, तेषां their, साह्यं help, कुरुष्व render, ह indeed.

40022667.author: Translation
40022667.content: O Vishnu, all these gods indeed await you; therefore, render them great help by slaying Vritra.

40022668.author: पदार्थः
40022668.content: त्वया by you, हि indeed, नित्यशः always, साह्यं help, कृतम् rendered, एषां of these, महात्मनाम् great-souled ones, असह्यम् unbearable, इदम् this, अन्येषाम् for others, अगतीनां of those without refuge, गतिः refuge, भवान् you.

40022668.author: Translation
40022668.content: Indeed, you have always rendered help to these great-souled ones, for this task is unbearable for others, and you are the sole refuge for the helpless. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 84 ।। Thus ends the eighty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
